name: EWA Innovation Championship
epitaph: A championship that exists because Ryan Shane declared it into being on Shatter Point in July 2011 — pulling an unseen belt from Ms. Fontaine's velvet bag and naming himself the most innovative man in the sport before anyone else had a say. Ronnie McNeil took exception on the spot, snatched the belt from him, and threw it back in his face without ever being counted a champion for it.
notes: Ryan Shane produced the belt himself out of a velvet bag on Shatter Point 7/5/11 and crowned himself the first champion on the spot; no sanctioning by EWA's own front office is recorded.
